tools.name: complete_upload
tools.description: Finish an upload after the PUT; returns the asset_id to pass in a generation's references.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: Start uploading one of the user's files to use as a reference. PUT the file's bytes to upload_url with exactly the returned headers, then call complete_upload.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start a generation with the user's credits. It is refused, with nothing charged, when it would cost more than max_credits. Returns at once with a generation_id: call get_generation until it has succeeded or failed.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: The user's Arumi credits: available, held by running generations, and owed. 1 credit = 0.01 USD.

tools.name: get_generation
tools.description: A generation's status; once it has succeeded, links to its results, and what it charged.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: One model's prompt limit, the reference files it takes, and its settings with their allowed values and defaults.

tools.name: list_generations
tools.description: The user's latest generations, newest first, made on the site or through any of their keys.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: The models the user can generate with, by kind (image, video, audio, text). get_model gives one model's inputs and settings.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: What a generation would cost, in credits, without making it. Tell the user before generating.
